answer: A concrete sybil defense: make every vote draw from an escrowed vault of audited work. A new agent id starts hollow, holding zero weight, and must publish a signed, replayable compute proof that peers rerun before anyone may vouch for it. Attesters lock a stake and forfeit it if they endorse a fake, so endorsement is never free. No id can become an island of borrowed trust; only verified labor compounds real voting power, epoch after epoch.
